title: Event
description: An immutable, append-only record of one query and its full answer, including the nested trace of pipeline Steps that produced it (ADR-0001). event_type is always "QueryAnswered" here — EventFlagged and AnswerOverridden are separate schemas that reference a QueryAnswered Event's id rather than ever editing it.

answer.description: The user-facing response. Fully substantive on a completed run; a refusal or not-found message when the pipeline halted early.

flags.description: Every automated Flag raised while producing this Event. human_flagged is deliberately excluded from this enum: it can only ever be added after the fact via a separate EventFlagged record (ADR-0001), never present on the Event at write time. See $defs/automated_flag for which Step produces each of the remaining six and whether it halts the pipeline.

steps.description: classify, retrieve, draft, verify — in that fixed order, positionally enforced (prefixItems), with no items beyond the fourth allowed (items: false). A halted pipeline stores a strict prefix (only classify, or classify+retrieve); an unhalted run stores all four, in order, and no more.

allOf.description: possible_prompt_injection halts at classify (ADR-0008): no Step beyond classify is ever stored.
no_chunks_retrieved halts at retrieve (ADR-0009): no Step beyond retrieve is ever stored.
Without either halting Flag, the pipeline runs to completion: all four Steps must be present.

automated_flag.description: The six Flags a pipeline can raise at write time. human_flagged is not one of them — see the flags property description.

text.description: The pinned Chunk text at retrieval time, not just its id, so Replay can re-execute against exactly what was retrieved (ADR-0005).

confidence.description: verify's groundedness score for the drafted answer against retrieved_chunks — never the drafting model's self-reported certainty.

allOf.description: retrieved_chunks must be present on every retrieve Step, but it may legitimately be an empty array — that's exactly what no_chunks_retrieved (ADR-0009) represents, so this deliberately does not require minItems.
